## Glyphling 1.1.0

Download `Glyphling-Setup-1.1.0.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place, keeping settings, themes and position. If you already have Glyphling, it will also offer this update by itself.

### What's new
- **Languages**: English, Italiano, Español and Français, in Settings › Widget › Language. The first run follows the Windows language (English if it is not offered); the tray menu follows it too.
- **New interactions**: move the mouse in circles around the ring and the mascot gets dizzy (and, after a few seconds, sick); hold the right button and rub it to pet it; click it six times fast to tickle it; poke it while it sleeps to make it yawn. It also says hello once a day, sways to the music, and blows a bubble while asleep. Shaking the mouse no longer makes it sick.
- **Updates**: Settings › Info now shows the real state of the automatic check (on or off, time of the last check) and the channel is "stable". The empty pill next to the update button is gone and the layout has more room.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway"). Glyphling is not affiliated with Nothing.
